params.prompt:
Create one exceptionally refined, production-ready premium collectible trading-card print. Output portrait 2:3 at high 2K quality. Orthographic front view, absolutely flat thin printed card with tiny satin bevel, smooth 63:88 rounded silhouette, precise manufacturable edges. No case, slab, pedestal, 3D thickness, protruding ornaments, words floating outside or perspective.
REFERENCE PRIORITY: Image 1 is the CURRENT approved Launch a Card v2 FRONT and is authoritative ONLY for the shared content grid, thin print construction and collector quality. Image 2 is the EXACT real asset identity and is authoritative for recognizable emblem/mascot shape, proportions, pose and colors. Replace every existing Doge motif in Image 1 unless this is the DOGE request. Do not copy its gold/black palette into a different identity.
SHARED FRONT GRID measured relative to the card: all live content spans x10%–90%. Leave a clean LIGHT warm-ivory/pearl writing surface for the name at y5.5%–11.5%. Leave a completely clear creator-art aperture x10%–90%,y15%–59%, with no logo, mascot, objects, illustration or live text inside it. Leave a LIGHT clean narrow ticker/pair writing strip y61.5%–64.9%. Leave a LIGHT continuous clean description writing surface x10%–90%,y67%–92.5%. These paper surfaces must be light enough for dark near-black printed ink. Do not make those live text surfaces dark. No footer slots, no serial, no market-cap box, no token number, no platform label. The bottom below the description must continue the native themed material to the rounded bottom edge, without extra empty boxes.
The asset identity belongs only in small impeccable motifs in the outer perimeter rails/corner hardware, never covering or duplicating the creator art. Material treatment, finish, foil edges and ornamental detail must clearly express this exact asset. Restrained depth, coherent studio light, meticulous micro-engraving and polished material separation. Preserve the useful blank content areas. No generated placeholder type, theme title, token data, watermark or decorative caption. Authentic letters that are part of the supplied exact logo are allowed only within that logo; no new lettering.

EXACT ASSET IDENTITY: apeonfone (fone). The exact brown young monkey seated and looking down at the black smartphone held in both hands, preserving the face, pose and phone silhouette. The supplied Image 2 is identity authority; preserve its actual shapes, colors and expression.
BESPOKE FRONT: Use warm brown ceramic, satin bronze and cream pearl. Integrate only small source-faithful identity details in the outer perimeter, outside all shared creator-content apertures.
Support material colors: #33271C, #B28B5B, #EADFC8. Preserve identity colors; no incidental source slogans, photograph background, captions, signage or text. Only exact intrinsic identity-logo lettering is allowed. No added words. Keep all live print surfaces LIGHT and blank.
Omit scene signage, clothing slogans, dictionary prose, captions and platform UI from source photos. Only exact identity logo lettering approved by the owner may appear; do not add theme names, serials or labels.
